name: Jim Bridenstine
summary: James Frederick Bridenstine (born June 15, 1975) is an American politician and military pilot who served as the 13th administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). Bridenstine was the United States representative for Oklahoma's 1st congressional district, based in Tulsa from January 3, 2013, to April 23, 2018. He is a member of the Republican Party.
